d: As a Contract Specialist, you will play a key role in protecting Hitachi Energy's contractual and commercial interests throughout the project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Sales, Supply Chain, Legal, and other stakeholders, this position supports successful project execution by identifying contractual risks and opportunities, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and driving effective contract administration from tender phase through project close-out.
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to commercial excellence, support strategic business objectives, and help deliver projects that advance a sustainable energy future.
q: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Engineering, Business Administration, Commercial Management, or a related discipline.
2-5 years of experience in contract management, commercial management, project execution, procurement, or a related project-based environment.
Good understanding of contractual terms and conditions, risk management, change management, claims administration, and commercial aspects of project execution.
Ability to analyze complex contractual matters and provide practical, business-oriented solutions.
Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently with limited supervision while effectively collaborating across functions and geographies.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and contract management tools is an advantage.
Fluency in written and spoken English.
r: Review and assess contracts, specifications, schedules, and other contractual documentation to identify risks, opportunities, ambiguities, and potential commercial exposures.
Support tender preparation, proposal reviews, and contract negotiations while contributing to the development and implementation of effective contract management strategies.
Establish and maintain the contractual baseline at project kick-off and monitor compliance with contractual obligations throughout project execution.

Partner with Project Managers and cross-functional teams to manage contractual and commercial matters, including change orders, variations, claims, extensions of time, payments, warranties, and guarantees.
Prepare, evaluate, support, and negotiate contractual claims and change requests with customers, suppliers, and subcontractors.
Monitor compliance with contractual notice requirements, reporting obligations, milestones, deliverables, and other key commitments.
Proactively identify contractual and commercial risks and opportunities and develop appropriate mitigation or opportunity plans in collaboration with project stakeholders.
Support the preparation, review, and administration of purchase orders, subcontracts, and supply agreements, ensuring appropriate flow-down of contractual obligations.
Collaborate with Legal and other functions on contract interpretation, dispute resolution, claims management, and contractual negotiations.
Support compliance with applicable insurance, trade compliance, export control, and governance requirements.
Maintain accurate contractual records and documentation, including correspondence, notices, amendments, claims, and commercial registers.

Support contract close-out activities by ensuring contractual obligations have been fulfilled, outstanding matters are resolved, and lessons learned are captured and shared for continuous improvement.
You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
